A fictitious A4 document

Every sentence in this document is invented. It shows the MedQuantis document module: the page on the canvas colour, the body in Newsreader, the label in Geist Mono capitals and headings in Outfit 500.

A block that stays whole

A block marked doc-keep never splits across two pages, like a figure, a card or a table row in a MedQuantis report.
